_comment: Conversations section settings (owner decision 2026-10-15). staleAfterMinutes: an unread, inbound-last conversation counts as stale once its last message is older than this. businessHours: the window used for response times, in America/New_York; days use 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday; endHour is exclusive (7 and 20 = 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM). optOutKeywords and interestKeywords are matched case-insensitively as whole words in inbound message text. replyWindowDays: how long after an inbound message a human reply still counts as a reply to it. withinMinutes: the 'replied within' target shown on the response-time card.
